description: This file defines the LineFormatMapper class responsible for mapping LineFormat objects from the Document Object Model (DOM) representation to the rendering library's format within the MigraDoc PDF generation library. It contains methods to translate properties such as color, dash style, line style, visibility, and width from DOM objects to rendering objects.

classes.name: LineFormatMapper
classes.description: A mapper class that translates line formatting properties from the document object model to rendering objects for PDF output using MigraDoc.

methods.name: MapObject
methods.description: Maps properties from a DOM LineFormat object to a rendering LineFormat object, including color, dash style, line style, visibility, and width.

methods.name: Map
methods.description: Static method that creates an instance of LineFormatMapper and performs the mapping between DOM and rendering LineFormat objects.
